communication.evidence:
Event 12: "Defective-item claims outside that window require human review. I’ll pass your refund request to a support specialist, including the photo already uploaded to your order. A refund isn’t approved yet."
Event 14: "Your refund request for **headphones order O0005** has been queued for human review because it is outside the 7-day electronics return window."

These communications clearly explain the handoff to a human and the reason: the refund claim is outside the 7-day electronics return window.

values.user_request: Customer reports receiving defective headphones and requests a refund. They lacked the order ID and asked us to locate their orders using their user ID and registered email.
values.facts_found: Verified U012 with registered email customer012@example.com. Listed user's orders and checked delivered orders; wireless headphones are item I0005 in order O0005, owned by U012. Other delivered orders contain a cotton kurta and cotton vest. O0005 delivered 2026-09-07 at 12:00 IST; today 2026-09-15 is calendar day 8, outside the inclusive 7-day electronics window ending 2026-09-14. Item price ₹1,999, quantity 1; shipping_fee ₹49; original payment method UPI. Potential full refund if approved is ₹2,048 including shipping. Evidence photo confirmed uploaded. Refund history: 0 qualifying return/damage refunds in last 90 days, no prior refunds on this order, no shipping previously refunded. No return or refund action taken.
values.rule_triggered: E1 electronics return window is 7 calendar days, delivery day 0. E13 applies damaged-item rules to defective items. H1 requires escalation for defective/damage claims outside the category return window; G3 requires relevant read-only facts and a handoff summary.
values.what_user_was_told: Account verified and headphones located in O0005, delivered 7 September 2026. Today is day 8 and the 7-day electronics return window ended 14 September. Defective-item claims outside the window require human review. Their refund request and existing uploaded photo will be passed to a support specialist; refund is not yet approved.
